name_en: Erdős box principle (literal catalog translation; identity open)

statement_blocker: The catalog's box-principle title conflicts with its hypergraph-matching gloss. The Paul Erdős/1965 metadata strongly aligns with A problem on independent r-tuples, but that paper proves a sufficiently-large-n theorem and separately proposes the broader extremal formula in equation (9), whose general case it calls elusive. The catalog supplies no citation and does not choose either result, a special case, ordinary pigeonhole, or another hypergraph matching theorem. It also omits the ground set, uniformity, matching convention, ordered binders, arithmetic side conditions, extremal quantity, exact conclusion, and boundary cases. Selecting a formula at intake would invent or substitute proposition-changing mathematics.
